items.generation_prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE production-ready transparent RGBA weapon sprite for a detailed Japanese 2D side-view arcade game. Generate exactly ONE new original medieval Japanese TODAKE FUSETAKE YUMI bow BODY, an explicitly artistic reconstruction of a wood bow with a single bamboo strip bonded to its BACK (right convex face), exposed dark warm wooden belly and side on the left. Complete usable body, no cutaway. Distinct silhouette: comparatively shallow right-convex arc, subtle flattened upper-middle curve, gently stronger inward return of the short lower limb, narrow tapered wooden tips. Upright long top limb and short bottom limb. Grip center at 63 percent down full bow height. Three sparse small groups of narrow dark rattan lashing, with long naked wood areas, NOT evenly repeated many wide gold rings. Plain short brown leather spiral grip, subtly thicker than limbs, no crosshatched diamond wrap. Show the single light tan bamboo back lamination as a fine seam against a visibly broader dark wood belly. Fine natural bamboo grain, no shiny gold. Dimensions are a game composition: on a 1024x1536 transparent canvas, bow from about y=48 to y=1488, upper tip about x=425, lower tip about x=450, rightmost convex edge about x=610. Limb thickness 18-24 pixels, grip width 28 pixels. Grip center y=955, handle length about100pixels. This is a thin practical Japanese bow, not fantasy. Both ends fully visible with padding. Style: refined hand-painted pixel-painterly 2D sprite, crisp fine dark contours and controlled cel-like highlights, clean natural material shading; not a photograph or 3D render. STRICT TRANSPARENCY: only the solid bow body is visible, all empty background is genuine alpha ZERO, no colored background, no gray haze, no ambient glow, no shadow, no diffuse aura, no checkerboard painted into image. Opaque weapon interior; hard silhouette edge with at most one-pixel antialiasing. No bowstring anywhere (engine draws string), no arrow, no people, hands, stand, labels, numbers, text, borders, metal plates, gems, ornaments or effects. Do not recreate the old generic deep C-shaped gold-band bow. Exactly one tall isolated original bow.
